vizulla.metaTitle: Vizulla Browser — fast, private and free
vizulla.metaDescription: Download Vizulla, the fast, private browser from Universal Bridge: built-in ad and tracker blocking, an on-device assistant, passwords and profiles. Free for macOS, Windows and Linux.
vizulla.title: Vizulla Browser
vizulla.lead: Blocks ads and trackers, keeps your passwords safe and brings an assistant that runs on your computer. Free, in four languages.

download.macIntel: Mac with an Intel chip? Get the Intel version

features.title: Everything you need, nothing that follows you
features.lead: Vizulla is built on the same engine as Chrome, so your sites just work, with privacy and helpful tools built in.

shields.title: Ads and trackers blocked
shields.body: Shields stop ads, trackers and cookie pop-ups on every site, so pages load faster.

assistant.title: An assistant on your computer
assistant.body: Summarise a page or ask about it. It runs on your device, so what you read stays with you.

tabs.title: Tabs that stay organised
tabs.body: Tabs on top or on the side, tab groups and Spaces for work and home.

passwords.title: Passwords, handled
passwords.body: Save, fill and create strong passwords, protected by your computer's lock.

profiles.title: A profile for everyone
profiles.body: Each person or role gets their own profile, with separate history, passwords and settings.

languages.title: Speaks your language
languages.body: Use Vizulla in English, Kiswahili, French or Kinyarwanda. Websites are asked for your language too.

install.title: Install Vizulla in three steps
install.lead: Pick your system. Vizulla updates itself afterwards: an update button appears in the toolbar when a new version is out.

s1.title: Open the download
s1.body: Double-click the .dmg file in your Downloads folder.

s2.title: Drag Vizulla to Applications
s2.body: Drag the Vizulla icon onto the Applications folder, then eject the installer.

s3.title: Open it the first time
s3.body: macOS asks you to confirm apps from outside the App Store. Open Vizulla, click Done, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. You only do this once.

s1.title: Run the installer
s1.body: Open the .exe file from your Downloads folder.

s2.title: Confirm the app
s2.body: If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.

s3.title: Start browsing
s3.body: Vizulla opens when the installation finishes and adds a shortcut to the Start menu.

s1.title: Allow it to run
s1.body: Right-click the AppImage, open Properties and turn on Allow executing as program.

s2.title: Open Vizulla
s2.body: Double-click the AppImage. Using the .deb package instead? Open it with your software installer.

s3.title: Keep it up to date
s3.body: The AppImage updates itself. With the .deb package, install new versions from this page.
